meta.name: opencode-obsidian
meta.description: 連接 Obsidian，讓 OpenCode 讀寫第二大腦筆記。說「連接 Obsidian」「設定 Obsidian vault」時載入。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 连接 Obsidian 笔记库，让 OpenCode 读写你的笔记
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你使用 Obsidian 记录笔记并希望从 OpenCode 中访问它们
copy.tagline_en: Connect to Obsidian vault to read and write your notes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Obsidian for note-taking and need OpenCode to access your notes

howto.what: 让OpenCode能读写你的Obsidian笔记。它会自动找到你的笔记库位置，安装连接工具，设置配置文件，并测试能否读取和写入。
howto.when: 当你说“连接 Obsidian”或“设定 Obsidian vault”时触发。

say.text: 请列出我的 Obsidian vault 根目录的文件夹。
请帮我建立第二大脑的三层文件夹结构。
say.note: 如果尚未设定，会创建每日笔记、创作库、知识库三个文件夹。

howto.what_en: Enables OpenCode to read and write your Obsidian notes. It locates your vault, installs the connection tool, adjusts configuration, and verifies read/write capability.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'Connect Obsidian' or 'Set Obsidian vault'.

say_en.text: List the folders in the root of my Obsidian vault.
Create a test note in Obsidian saying 'OpenCode successfully connected to Obsidian'.
Set up the three-layer folder structure for my second brain.
say_en.note: Creates daily notes, creation library, and knowledge base if missing.
